name: My bathroom is outdated – where do I even start with remodeling?

step.name: Step 1: Define Your Vision and Budget — Think about your ideal style, color palette, and must-have features (e.g., a walk-in shower, double vanity, smart storage). Equally important, establish a realistic budget. This will guide all your subsequent decisions. It's okay if you're not sure about exact costs yet; just a range helps.
step.text: Step 1: Define Your Vision and Budget — Think about your ideal style, color palette, and must-have features (e.g., a walk-in shower, double vanity, smart storage). Equally important, establish a realistic budget. This will guide all your subsequent decisions. It's okay if you're not sure about exact costs yet; just a range helps.

step.name: Step 2: Prioritize and Plan the Layout — Decide what's non-negotiable. Is it more counter space? A larger shower? Consider if you need to move plumbing fixtures. If you're keeping the current layout, it’ll be less costly. If you're dreaming of a tub-to-shower conversion or moving walls, that requires more planning and professional involvement.

step.name: Step 3: Choose Your Materials and Finishes — This is where your vision comes to life! Select tiles for floors and walls, vanity style and countertop material, fixtures (faucets, showerheads), lighting, and paint colors. Think about durability and how they’ll fit your lifestyle. For example, some materials are better for high-moisture areas.

step.name: Step 4: Hire a Reputable Contractor — This is crucial for a smooth project, especially in areas like Las Vegas where permits and code compliance are important. A licensed, bonded, and insured general contractor like Simply Construction will manage permits, coordinate trades, and ensure the work meets quality and safety standards. They’ll help keep your project on track and within budget.

step.name: Step 5: Enjoy Your New Space! — Once everything is done and inspected, it’s time to relax and enjoy your beautifully transformed bathroom. A good contractor will do a final walkthrough with you to ensure every detail is perfect.
